mapper.select: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_REVERSAL ( CURRENT_TRX_NO, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ, AMOUNT, REVERSAL_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{reversal.reversalPosTrx}, #{reversal.originalPosTrx}, #{reversal.originalAttemptSeq}, #{reversal.amount}, #{reversal.reversalStatusValue} ) RETURNING CURRENT_TRX_NO AS reversalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, AMOUNT AS amount, REVERSAL_STATUS AS reversalStatus, VAN_REVERSAL_TRX_ID AS vanReversalTrxId, REVERSAL_APPROVAL_NO AS reversalApprovalNo, DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode

UPDATE PAYMENT_REVERSAL SET REVERSAL_STATUS = #{reversal.reversalStatusValue}, VAN_REVERSAL_TRX_ID = #{reversal.vanReversalTrxId}, REVERSAL_APPROVAL_NO = #{reversal.reversalApprovalNo}, DECLINE_CODE = #{reversal.declineCode}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CURRENT_TRX_NO = #{reversal.reversalPosTrx} AND ORIGINAL_TRX_NO = #{reversal.originalPosTrx} AND ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ = #{reversal.originalAttemptSeq} AND REVERSAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' RETURNING CURRENT_TRX_NO AS reversalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, AMOUNT AS amount, REVERSAL_STATUS AS reversalStatus, VAN_REVERSAL_TRX_ID AS vanReversalTrxId, REVERSAL_APPROVAL_NO AS reversalApprovalNo, DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode

SELECT R.CURRENT_TRX_NO AS reversalPosTrx, R.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, R.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, R.AMOUNT AS amount, R.REVERSAL_STATUS AS reversalStatus, R.VAN_REVERSAL_TRX_ID AS vanReversalTrxId, R.REVERSAL_APPROVAL_NO AS reversalApprovalNo, R.DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode FROM PAYMENT_REVERSAL R WHERE R.CURRENT_TRX_NO = #{reversalPosTrx} LIMIT 1

SELECT R.CURRENT_TRX_NO AS reversalPosTrx, R.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, R.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, R.AMOUNT AS amount, R.REVERSAL_STATUS AS reversalStatus, R.VAN_REVERSAL_TRX_ID AS vanReversalTrxId, R.REVERSAL_APPROVAL_NO AS reversalApprovalNo, R.DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode FROM PAYMENT_REVERSAL R WHERE R.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO = #{originalPosTrx} AND R.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ = #{originalAttemptSeq} LIMIT 1
